evidence.claim: Adiya speakers call themselves raavuleeru; Wayanad localities printed.
Ravula has alternative name Adiya and code ravu1237, ISO yea.
Nair 2013 chapter Adiya associated with Ravula [yea] in indexed language-code statement; landing page search snippet, exact page access not independently retrieved.

jambu_baseline: Ravula already registered (ravu1237; S. Dravidian I) with 148 canonical forms in 20260911-dravlex.csv. Adiya is absent as a named dialect and Nair 2013 has no existing source rows. Reuse Ravula base; propose a language-qualified Adiya source dialect without inferred point.
coordinates: No exact elicitation point is identified; retain blank rather than reusing a modern centroid.
source_lect: Adiya in Wayanad may be represented by a language-qualified source dialect beneath Ravula, not a pseudo-language.
